_note: The coach's season goals (GDD 4.9.2 'Season goals with times', session C5; SeasonGoals). With the autumn plan offer (and for a season that started without one) the coach offers three goals for the season: a TIME, a MILESTONE (a real standard from data/standards.json, or a place at one of your target meets) and a HABIT (a process goal). For each the player picks one of up to four levels (user 2026-10-16: a free choice from a short list); the coach has marked his own pick. HOW HE PICKS: he estimates the time you will be able to run in the season's peak (the 800 m ability at the date of your last target, projected through the season plan on a copy of the career, with the race-day form of that race and the best-of-a-few-races gain `best_of`), as seen through his judging ability (his estimate is off by a share of the time with sd = noise.floor + noise.per_point x (20 - judging ability): a poor judge sets goals that are too easy or too hard). The levels are offsets from that estimate (levels[].offset: + = slower = easier); his pick follows his demands (pick: steady = the first level, balanced = the second, ambitious = the third) moved by `lean` (what you told him after a missed goal, -2..2). A milestone's levels are real things sorted by the time they need (standards of your age class, a top-8 or medal place at a target meet from the rival pool) and each is called by its `from` ratio to his estimate. MET / MISSED: a goal is met the moment it is reached (a message, trust + trust.met, + trust.higher when you chose a level above his pick); open goals are settled together on the evening before the next season in ONE review talk with replies; a missed goal costs nothing (trust.missed 0): the replies only tell him how to set the next goals (lean). The estimate and the goals are saved with the career. All numbers and every text of the goals live here.

intro.calm: Let's agree what this season is for. For each goal I have marked the level I would choose. Pick yours; there is no wrong answer, only a different price.
intro.drill: Goals. A season without numbers is a season without work. My picks are marked. Take them or aim higher; don't aim lower without a reason.
intro.warm: I'd like us to want the same things this season. My picks are marked. If something feels too much or too little, choose differently and we'll talk about it.
intro.tactician: Three targets for the season. Each level has a price in risk and a chance of coming off; my estimate is under each. My picks are marked.

text.calm: You did it: {goal_lc}. That's what the work was for. Enjoy it for a day; then we go on.
